MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 46
   C. 120
   D. 30

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15.7

4. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

6. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 10
   C. 100
   D. 11

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 88
   B. 38
   C. 22
   D. 19

8. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

9. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19

10. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

11. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
